SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 40.
Foreign Section, Station,
Date 14. - . 1. - 30.
Date January 11, 1930.

Subject (in full) Arrival of Soviet Agent.

Made by P.C.P.S. Medvedeff. Forwarded by Theo Robertson C.D.I.

The undermentioned Soviet Agent arrived in Shanghai
on January 9, 1930 from Tsinanfu via Tsingtao in the s.s.
"Hoten Maru."

A.L. Alshuler- Soviet Agent and former member
of the staff of the Soviet
Consulate at Tientsin. Ex-
Manager of the Behr & Mathew
Egg Company, Tsinanfu.
Proceeded to Rue du Roi Albert.

N. Medvedeff
P. C. P. S.

AM 11/30

A/D. C. I.
13:1:30

Ac.(Pol)
naval authorities
13/1 Recd

Reg.
For attention

Copies sent.
O.T. 14.1.30.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. I. D. REGISTRY No. I. O. D. 40 Central I. B. Date February 18, 1929.）

Subject (in full) A. L. Alshuler alias Atshuler

Made by P.C.S. Maklaevsky Forwarded by J.N. Owens A.C. P.C.

The undermentioned Soviet Agent left Shanghai for
Tientsin via Tsingtao on February 12, 1929 by the s.s. "Hoten
Maru" :

A. L. Alshuler Soviet Agent. Member of
alias Atshuler the Staff of the Soviet
Consulate in Tientsin.

Maklaevsky
P.C.S.

A/D.C.I.

Lee

HR. 19/2/29

Ref. No. d/ February 18, 1929.
Copies to H.B.M. Consul, Capt. Shelley, Col. Halland, Lieut. Carlson.
20/2 Shea

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C.I.D. REGISTRY CENTRAL I. R. O.）
Date February 8, 1929

Subject (in full) : Arrival of Soviet Agent.

Made by P.C.S. Maklaevsky Forwarded by J. Kivens A.B. Pol

The undermentioned Soviet agent arrived in Shanghai
from Tientsin via Dairen on February 6, 1929 by the s.s.
"Dairen Maru":-
A. L. Alshuler Soviet Agent. Member of the
Staff of the Soviet Consulate
in Tientsin.
Inquiries are proceeding re his whereabouts.

B. Maklaevsky
P. C. S.

A/ D.C.I.

Lia

MR. 9 2/7

Ref. No. d/ February 8, 1929.
Copies forwarded for information to:-
H.B.M. Consul
Capt. J.P. Shelley, North China Command.
Lieut. Col G.H.R. Halland, O.B.E., N. China Command.
Lieut. E. F. Carlson, U.S. Marine Corps.
